message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
Pebble Spring watched the masons shape blocks into walls.
The creature marked each joint with a soft glowing sign.
It listened to the stories the workers told at rest.
Pebble Spring copied the patterns into its own notes.
The city gave it tools and a small workshop.
It learned to measure a doorway with careful care.
Its wooden staff hummed whenever a beam was cut.
Pebble Spring helped a family build a shelter.
The stone walls rose quickly under gentle magic.
It admired the bridges that spanned the river.
The paved ground made walking easier every day.
Pebble Spring painted the new rooms with bright colors.
Its work was steady, patient, and full of wonder.
The villagers noticed the Leshy by the open door.
It offered a hand to any house in need.
The garden behind the workshop bloomed in spring.
Pebble Spring counted the birds that nested in eaves.
It traced the shadows along the evening wall.
The quiet town felt safe beneath its watchful care.
The small Leshy walked along the long cobblestone street, examined the bright lanterns, counted the windows, traced the paving stones, watched the birds, heard the distant bells, and finally declared the quiet evening was spotty.
